To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) GNPs induce an acute phase response in rat livers that is more pronounced with the higher diameter GNPs and recedes on day 5, 2) the real-time PCR is more sensitive than immunostaining for measuring the proinflammatory response, and 3) the proinflammatory cytokine mRNA expression is more pronounced than their proteins expression.
the 10nm and the 50nm GNPS induced a significant increase in the proinflammatory response in rat liver, which receded after 5days.
the immunostaining and PCR techniques can be used as complementary techniques for measuring cytokines expression in tissues.
